features.name: Notes Infinite Scroll (2026-08-13)
features.description: DONE: replaced client-side page pagination with infinite scroll. New useInfiniteNotes (useInfiniteQuery; key excludes page so sort/search/view changes reset the list; initialPageParam from URL page for deep links; getNextPageParam isLast ? undefined : page+1). useNotesView flattens pages (useMemo) and returns infinite { fetchNextPage, hasNextPage, isFetchingNextPage } in place of pagination; notes-view-page removes <Paginator> usage (file + usePagination hook kept on disk) and appends an IntersectionObserver sentinel (root: scroll container, rootMargin 200px, guarded by hasNextPage && !isFetchingNextPage) with an inline spinner. Loaded pages stay in react-query cache (refetchOnWindowFocus already false in main.tsx) - no re-fetch on scroll-up; pageSize 20 unchanged. Virtualization deferred (user chose plain infinite scroll; @tanstack/react-virtual already installed for a later phase). BUGFIX (2026-08-13): getNextPageParam previously derived the next page from the backend's echoed page field (Spring PageResponse echoes 0-indexed page.getNumber()), so next pageParam always computed back to 1 -> infinite re-fetch of page 1 with duplicates; fixed to derive from lastPageParam (the actual requested pageParam, 1-indexed per NoteQueryParams API contract) -> pages now advance 1,2,3... and stop when isLast. Verified: check, tsc -b, build (7044 modules).

features.description: DONE: (1) Create-note prefill moved off ?content= into transient src/store/note-create-prefill-store.ts (set/consume one-shot); callers chat-bot handleCreateNote (truncates to NOTE_CONTENT_MAX_LENGTH=1500 constant in notes/constants.ts, reused by schemas.ts) + command-palette /create; notes/create.tsx dropped validateSearch content/stripSearchParams; use-note-create consumes store on mount with setValue(..., { shouldDirty: true, shouldValidate: true }) — fixes prefilled form Save staying disabled (was: defaultValues → never dirty). (2) Streaming UI: action buttons hidden while the last message streams (plain path MessageActions gated !isStreaming && !isEditing; branch path MessageToolbar fully hidden) — shimmer-only look; Reasoning already default-closed (defaultOpen={false} → ai-elements isExplicitlyClosed). (3) User-message versioning: getVersionInfo now filters siblings by role (fixes mixed user-edit/assistant siblings appearing as versions in both selectors); MessageView branch UI applies to any role (assistant toolbar = Retry+Copy+MoreMenu, user = Edit+Copy); edit works inside branch content (isEditing/save/cancel per sibling id, MessageEditForm keyed by message.id). (4) Note details restore: NEW api/use-restore-note.ts (PATCH ACTIVE, restored toasts); use-note-details exposes restoreNote + isRestoring; $noteId shows Restore (RotateCcwIcon, notes_card_restore) instead of Move to trash on desktop + mobile dropdown when note.trashed; isBusy includes isRestoring. (5) Dead code: companion-context-bar.tsx + companion-quick-actions.tsx deleted (both were imported-but-never-rendered — clears both app-right-sidebar lint warnings); companion_context_* orphan keys removed (en/vi); companion_quick_* keys + config/companion-prompts.ts kept (consumed by NoteAttachmentSuggestions). (6) Include-in-chat suggestions race FIXED: NoteAttachmentSync merged to one effect — add store→input first, prune only when nothing pending, over-cap toast once (maxFilesToastShownRef) then prune. (7) R7 (user report): version switch showed only up-to-selected-message (following messages vanished) — switchVersion now walks first-child chain to deepest descendant (Claude-style branch display; childrenIds[0] = original continuation; no-op guard kept); getVersionInfo no longer bails on parentId===null and derives root siblings by scanning null-parent nodes (first message edit now shows a selector); handleSwitchVersion PATCHes the deepest leaf id (not the selected version id) so reloads restore the same full branch. Verified: generate-translation, check (pre-existing warnings only), tsc -b, build (7082 modules).

features.description: DONE (per user: "include note files through prompt attachments, NOT NoteAttachmentSync ... DO NOT use any beside prompt attachments"; suggestions removed per "NoteAttachmentSuggestions => remove this" / "remove unused"; NO ai-elements files touched). (1) Notes now enter the composer as plain prompt-attachment files: chat-note-attachment-store.ts slimmed to a one-shot pending queue (ChatNoteAttachment / buildNoteChatAttachment / add / clear / MAX_CHAT_ATTACHMENTS; replace + remove deleted). PromptInputAttachmentsDisplay (features/companion/components/chat-attachment.tsx) is the single injection point - consume-once effect reads the pending store, attachments.add(pending.slice(0, capacity).map((n) => n.file)) (toast chat_attachments_max when at cap), then clear(). Producers (use-note-card.ts includeInChat, $noteId.tsx includeInChat) unchanged. Included note renders as a removable chip (AttachmentRemove) like any manual upload; store cleared at injection. (2) Agent->chat mode-switch guard (user rule: carry the conversation only when it has messages and is in use; otherwise /chat + null). nav-companion.tsx handleLayoutModeChange now computes hasMessages = (activeConversationId in useGetConversationsQuery list) OR (queryClient cache ["companion-conversation-messages", id] has non-empty pages) -> navigate /chat/$conversationId only then; else setActiveConversationId(null) + navigate /chat. Fixes the reported bug: stale/deleted conversation id navigated to /chat/<id> showing empty chat (silent 404, no error UI) + no sidebar highlight. useQueryClient imported. Verified: generate-translation, check (pre-existing warnings only), tsc -b, build (7058 modules). No i18n changes (no new/removed user-facing strings; chat_attachments_max reused). features.name: Shortcut Mapping Overhaul + Bulk-Bar Trash Semantics + Markdown Link in Toolbar (2026-08-17)
features.description: DONE (per user spec): (1) New global shortcut mapping: go-to-notes = 'g n' sequence (G then N, navigate /notes), go-to-create-note = ['c', 'mod+n'] (was mod+alt+n), toggle-theme = 'mod+alt+t' (Ctrl+Alt+T → useTheme().toggleTheme()); quick-note (mod+alt+n popup) DROPPED per user (app has no quick-note feature). Sequence support added to GlobalShortcutsProvider: combos containing whitespace register via getSequenceManager().register(steps, ...) (HotkeyManager.register does not accept sequences); handles map typed structurally (setOptions/unregister shared by both handle types). Input protection verified in library source (manager.utils.js): shouldIgnoreInputEvent covers input/textarea/select/contentEditable via focused element + composedPath, so 'c'/'g n'/'mod+n' stay inert while typing (useHotkeyShortcut registers ignoreInputs: true by default). findShortcutConflict now normalizes sequences token-wise. (2) Bulk bar semantics: TRASH button in notes-bulk-actions.tsx said notes_bulk_delete ('Delete') but performs move-to-trash — relabeled to new notes_bulk_move_to_trash ('Move to trash'/'Chuyển vào thùng rác'), orphaned notes_bulk_delete removed; audit of per-card dropdown, $noteId inline actions, trash view, and TRASH toast (notes_page_toast_trashed) confirmed already correct. (3) Markdown info moved OUT of the shortcuts dialog title into the toolbar as a small 'Markdown' link (new key lexical_shortcuts_markdown, title = lexical_shortcuts_tooltip_info) next to ShortcutsHelpDialog; dialog title cleaned up. (4) Shortcuts dialogs scoped: sidebar-keyboard-shortcuts-dialog now shows ['global'] only (editor dialog was already ['editor']). New i18n en/vi: keyboard_shortcuts_go_to_notes, keyboard_shortcuts_toggle_theme, notes_bulk_move_to_trash, lexical_shortcuts_markdown. Verified: generate-translation, bun --bun check (exit 0), bunx tsc -b, bun --bun run build.
